title: Charming, quiet and hip apt. Great neighborhood!
description:
Located in one of Nashville's hottest neighborhoods this funky and charming studio apartment is the top floor of the house.  Short walk to fabulous Five Points East Nashville where you'll find some of the best restaurants, bars, shops, galleries and happenings Nashville has to offer. Around the corner from groceries, coffee shops and more stores and restaurants.  10 min from airport and 5 min from downtown.  Great spot for couples, solo adventurers and business travelers.

The space
There is a cozy and artsy eating/work nook with a super comfortable love seat and multiple working or eating surfaces.   Great fully stocked kitchen for all your cooking desires.   The TV is loaded with a Netflix account and other streaming apps.  There is a separate laundry room you are welcome to use for free as well as a small outdoor seating area just outside the front door.  This AirBnB is fully insured with a proper permit.

Guest access
There is a separate laundry room you are welcome to use for free.  Located on the Edgewood Place side of the house.  Door to the left at the end of the driveway.

Other things to note
Please note that the bathroom is pretty small.  It's very cute but small....with a shower that if you are over 6 feet tall you may have to bend your head a bit : )   Also there is a flight of an outdoor staircase to climb to get up here.
